failure_modes.description: Sentences like 'I do not want to insult you' may be misflagged due to presence of the root word 'insult'.
failure_modes.mitigation: Preserving negation words during stop-word removal and utilizing unigram+bigram TF-IDF features.

failure_modes.description: Passive-aggressive bullying without overt profanity or slurs is frequently missed by bag-of-words classifiers.
failure_modes.mitigation: Requires contextual transformer representations (e.g. DistilBERT) or conversational thread history.

failure_modes.description: Friendly banter or reclamation of reclaimed terms among close peers is misclassified as toxic.
failure_modes.mitigation: Incorporating user moderation queue review before taking punitive actions.
